To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) a deep extension of an existing non parametric model allows to learn new classes in an end-to-end fashion; (ii) the proposed model can be used to detect unknown objects and to mine the Web for new classes; (iii) the model can be used on a robot platform to learn new categories autonomously.
a deep learning architecture, based on a non parametric deep extension, is able to detect whether a perceived object is known or not by the system and to learn new classes dynamically.

1) we propose the first deep learning architecture for open world object recognition, 2) the system can dynamically update its knowledge about the objects it sees in an end to-end fashion, and 3) we provide a proof-of-concept of the proposed approach on real robots.
